# DevOS `.gitignore` Standards

## Overview

Every DevOS-initialized project contains a `.dev-os/` directory with three distinct categories of content: authored artifacts that represent deliberate project decisions, durable recovery snapshots that must survive branch switches and context loss, and machine-local runtime artifacts that are ephemeral. Without a formal boundary between these categories, teams either blanket-ignore durable work or track regenerable cache data. This standard defines the correct posture, gives a copy-paste `.gitignore` block, and establishes a compliance test.

## Scope

This standard covers `.dev-os/` directory entries in any project that has run `start`. It does NOT cover `.claude/` command/skill symlinks outside `.dev-os/` (those are governed by the project's own install conventions), git workflow configuration, or `.gitignore` rules for non-DevOS files.

---

## Principles

1. **Authored artifacts are version-controlled by default.** Files written by humans — agent definitions, hook scripts, workflow markdown, config, curated standards — must be tracked. Losing them means losing project configuration.
2. **Machine-local runtime artifacts are regenerable.** Logs, caches, and extracted standards add noise to git history. Recovery checkpoints are the exception: their purpose requires version control.
3. **Explicit ignore beats negation chain.** Enumerate what to ignore; leave what to track implicit. Negation chains (`.dev-os/` + `!.dev-os/standards/` + `!.dev-os/standards/global/`) are ordering-dependent and silently lose dirs that were never negated.
4. **New runtime dirs must be declared explicitly.** When DevOS adds a new runtime directory in a future release, it must be added to both this standard and the consuming project's `.gitignore` proactively — not discovered after the fact via `git status`.

---

## Classification Table

| Path | Category | Track in git? | Rationale |
|------|----------|---------------|-----------|
| `.dev-os/config.yml` | AUTHORED | YES | Project DevOS configuration (profile, version, options) |
| `.dev-os/agents/*.md` | AUTHORED | YES | Agent definitions written by developers |
| `.dev-os/hooks/*.sh` | AUTHORED | YES | Project-level hook scripts written by developers |
| `.dev-os/workflows/` | AUTHORED | YES | Workflow markdown installed from the DevOS profile |
| `.dev-os/runtime/*.json`, `*.jsonl`, `*.yml`, `*.yaml`, `*.txt`, `*.ack`, `*.db`, `*-current`, `sessions/`, `checkpoints/`, `session-mode`, `DEVOS_*` | RUNTIME | NO | Generated per-session state, cache files, trace/database artifacts, mode markers, and runtime subdirectories |
| `.dev-os/runtime/context-ledger.json` | AUTHORED | YES | Cross-session context ledger — encodes "where am I" state for session continuity |
| `.dev-os/runtime/context-refresh-state.json` | AUTHORED | YES | Last context refresh state — enables cold-start recovery on new machine |
| `.dev-os/state/` | RUNTIME | NO | Cross-OS handoff state, Orca handles, workspace catalog cache, and design handoff state |
| `.dev-os/logs/` | RUNTIME | NO | `runtime-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` session logs |
| `.dev-os/cache/` | RUNTIME | NO | Context7/docs cache JSON — large, regenerable |
| `.dev-os/patches/` | RUNTIME | NO | Applied patch records |
| `.dev-os/reports/` | RUNTIME | NO | `context-refresh-latest.md` — generated report |
| `.dev-os/sessions/` | RUNTIME | NO | Legacy session checkpoint yml files |
| `.dev-os/checkpoints/` | RUNTIME | NO | Checkpoint yml files |
| `.dev-os/recovery/*/{checkpoint-*.yml,session-state.yml,ARCHIVED.yml}` | DURABLE | YES | Checkpoint and closeout state must survive branch switches, clones, and context loss |
| Other `.dev-os/recovery/*/*` entries | RUNTIME | NO | Scratch content is not part of the recovery contract |
| `.dev-os/profile` | RUNTIME | NO | Installed profile name — written by install script |
| `.dev-os/README.md` | RUNTIME | NO | Generated by `start` |
| `.dev-os/.claude/` | RUNTIME | NO | Installed commands/skills symlinks |
| `.dev-os/chains/` | AUTHORED | YES | Project-local chain definitions installed from the active profile |
| `.dev-os/runbooks/` | AUTHORED | YES | Project-local operational runbooks installed from the active profile |
| `.dev-os/scripts/` | AUTHORED | YES | Project-local helper scripts installed from the active profile |
| `.dev-os/bundles/` | AUTHORED | YES | Project-local context bundle definitions installed from the active profile |
| `.dev-os/standards/profile/` | AUTHORED | YES | Profile-synced standards that define the active project contract |
| `.dev-os/standards/global/` | AUTHORED | YES | Curated coding standards — project-owned |
| `.dev-os/standards/auth/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted by `extract-standards` — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/backend/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/cli/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/deployment/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/frontend/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/integration/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/architecture/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/testing/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/product/` | RUNTIME | NO | Extracted — regenerable |
| `.dev-os/standards/.last-extracted` | RUNTIME | NO | Timestamp for last extract-standards run |
| `.dev-os/standards/.profile-sync` | RUNTIME | NO | Profile sync state |
| `.dev-os/runtime/system-ops/` | RUNTIME | NO | `system-ops-visibility` finding ledger and action-card cache — nested runtime subdirectory, not covered by the top-level `.dev-os/runtime/*.json` glob |
| `.dev-os/config.yml.bak*` | RUNTIME | NO | Per-machine config backup snapshots written before config-mutating operations (e.g. `devos-init`, `sync-project-local`) |
| `.gitignore.bak.*` | RUNTIME | NO | Per-machine `.gitignore` backup snapshots written by `gitignore-hardening.sh` before rewriting the file |
| `.dev-os/standards/profile/.conflicts/` | RUNTIME | NO | Timestamped conflict snapshots written when profile-sync detects local edits to a synced standard |
| `.dev-os/design-review.yml` | AUTHORED | YES | Design review config — base URL, Doppler project/config for this project |

## Rules

### Rule 1 — Use the explicit runtime-ignore block (`MUST`)

Every DevOS-initialized project's `.gitignore` MUST contain the following block. Copy it verbatim:

```gitignore
# DevOS runtime artifacts (generated — do not track)
# runtime/ is NOT ignored as a directory; scoped file patterns keep portable
# context state trackable via explicit negations.
.dev-os/runtime/*.json
.dev-os/runtime/*.jsonl
.dev-os/runtime/*.yml
.dev-os/runtime/*.yaml
.dev-os/runtime/*.txt
.dev-os/runtime/*.ack
.dev-os/runtime/*.db
.dev-os/runtime/*-current
.dev-os/runtime/sessions/
.dev-os/runtime/checkpoints/
.dev-os/runtime/session-mode
.dev-os/runtime/DEVOS_*
.dev-os/runtime/system-ops/
!.dev-os/runtime/context-ledger.json
!.dev-os/runtime/context-refresh-state.json
.dev-os/state/
.dev-os/logs/
.dev-os/cache/
.dev-os/patches/
.dev-os/reports/
.dev-os/sessions/
.dev-os/checkpoints/
# Recovery snapshots are durable by design. Ignore scratch entries inside each
# recovery directory while keeping checkpoint, session, and closeout YAML trackable.
.dev-os/recovery/*/*
!.dev-os/recovery/*/checkpoint-*.yml
!.dev-os/recovery/*/session-state.yml
!.dev-os/recovery/*/ARCHIVED.yml
.dev-os/profile
.dev-os/README.md
.dev-os/.claude/

# DevOS standards: extracted standards are generated runtime artifacts.
# Curated standards live in global/; profile-synced standards live in profile/.
.dev-os/standards/auth/
.dev-os/standards/backend/
.dev-os/standards/cli/
.dev-os/standards/deployment/
.dev-os/standards/frontend/
.dev-os/standards/integration/
.dev-os/standards/architecture/
.dev-os/standards/testing/
.dev-os/standards/product/
.dev-os/standards/.last-extracted
.dev-os/standards/.profile-sync

# Per-machine backup and conflict snapshots (generated — do not track)
.dev-os/config.yml.bak*
.gitignore.bak.*
.dev-os/standards/profile/.conflicts/

# DevOS authored artifacts — DO NOT add these to .gitignore:
# .dev-os/config.yml          — project DevOS config
# .dev-os/agents/             — agent definitions
# .dev-os/hooks/              — hook scripts
# .dev-os/workflows/          — workflow markdown
# .dev-os/chains/             — workflow chain definitions
# .dev-os/runbooks/           — operational runbooks
# .dev-os/scripts/            — project-local helper scripts
# .dev-os/bundles/            — context bundle definitions
# .dev-os/standards/global/   — curated coding standards
# .dev-os/standards/profile/  — profile-synced standards
# .dev-os/design-review.yml   — design review base URL and Doppler config
```

### Rule 2 — Authored dirs are tracked by omission (`MUST`)

Do NOT add `.dev-os/agents/`, `.dev-os/hooks/`, `.dev-os/workflows/`, `.dev-os/chains/`, `.dev-os/runbooks/`, `.dev-os/scripts/`, `.dev-os/bundles/`, `.dev-os/standards/global/`, `.dev-os/standards/profile/`, or `.dev-os/config.yml` to `.gitignore`. These are authored artifacts. Their absence from the ignore list is intentional and means they are tracked.

### Rule 3 — New DevOS runtime dirs must be declared immediately (`MUST`)

When a DevOS release adds a new machine-local runtime directory or file class (e.g., `.dev-os/state/`, recovery scratch content, `.dev-os/runtime/*.db`, or `.dev-os/runtime/*-current`), add a corresponding scoped ignore line to `.gitignore` in every affected project before the next commit. Do not blanket-ignore a directory that contains durable files.
---

## Anti-patterns

| Anti-pattern | Why it fails | Correct alternative |
|---|---|---|
| `.dev-os/` + `!.dev-os/standards/` + `!.dev-os/standards/global/` (negation chain) | Fragile ordering. `agents/`, `hooks/`, `workflows/`, `config.yml` are never negated — they stay ignored silently. Adding a new authored dir requires remembering to add a negation. | Use the explicit runtime-ignore block from Rule 1. Authored dirs are tracked by default; only runtime dirs appear in `.gitignore`. |
| `.dev-os/agents/` in the ignore list | `agents/` contains authored markdown — ignoring it loses agent definitions from the repo. | Remove this line. `agents/` is authored and must be tracked. |
| `.dev-os/workflows/` in the ignore list | `workflows/` contains authored workflow markdown — ignoring it loses the project's DevOS workflow definitions. | Remove this line. `workflows/` is authored and must be tracked. |
| No `.dev-os/` rules at all | `.dev-os/cache/` can accumulate megabytes of Context7 JSON. On design-heavy projects, 21+ cache files tracked in git within days. | Add the canonical block from Rule 1. |
| `.dev-os/runtime/` (whole directory ignored) | Loses `context-ledger.json` and `context-refresh-state.json` — cloning to a new machine loses all session context continuity. Also: git cannot un-ignore files inside an ignored directory with `!` negations. | Ignore scoped runtime file classes (`.dev-os/runtime/*.json`, `*.jsonl`, `*.yml`, `*-current`, etc.) and then explicitly re-include the two portable context files. |
| `.dev-os/recovery/` plus writer-specific `git add -f` | Git cannot re-include durable files below an ignored parent, and every writer must remember a hidden exception. A missed `-f` silently loses recovery history. | Ignore `.dev-os/recovery/*/*`, negate the three durable YAML classes, and use plain `git add`. |

---

## Deviation Guidance

MAY omit individual extracted-standards subdirs from the ignore list if the profile genuinely does not produce them (e.g., a pure Bash `cli` profile has no `frontend/` standards). MUST keep runtime file-class rules, `.dev-os/state/`, `.dev-os/logs/`, and `.dev-os/cache/` in every project regardless of profile — these are produced by DevOS operations.

MAY add project-specific runtime dirs (e.g., `.dev-os/telemetry/` for a custom plugin) to the block. MUST document the new entry in the project's `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` so the classification remains auditable.

The `dev-os` source repo itself may add source-repo-only runtime paths such as `product/runtime/`, `product/gap-analysis/`, or installed cross-OS skill mirrors. Those rules MUST NOT be propagated blindly to consumer projects.

---

## Profile Inheritance Notes

This standard is defined in `profiles/general/standards/global/` and inherited by all consumer profiles:

- `webapp` (general → default → general)
- `cli` (general → default → general)
- `installable-os` (cli → general)
- `business`, `pwa`, `astro-client-sites`, `agents`, `skills`, `boxi-ops` (general → default → general)

No child profile overrides this standard. All profiles apply the same classification and the same canonical block.

## Compliance Test

Run these commands in any DevOS-initialized project to verify correct posture:

```bash
# 1. Authored dirs — should NOT be ignored (exit 1 = not ignored = correct)
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/agents/git-automation.md
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/hooks/user-prompt-submit.sh
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/workflows/git/
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/chains/deliver-product-slice.yaml
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runbooks/install-failure.md
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/scripts/deploy-prod.sh
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/bundles/bundle-manifest.json
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/config.yml
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/global/
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/profile/

# 1b. Portable runtime context and durable recovery snapshots — should NOT be ignored
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/context-refresh-state.json
git check-ignore --no-index -q .dev-os/recovery/demo/checkpoint-1.yml
git check-ignore --no-index -q .dev-os/recovery/demo/session-state.yml
git check-ignore --no-index -q .dev-os/recovery/demo/ARCHIVED.yml

# 2. Machine-local runtime artifacts — SHOULD be ignored (exit 0 = ignored)
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/session-state.yml
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/parallel-build-slice-current
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/command-probe-cache.json
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/state/
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/logs/
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/cache/
git check-ignore --no-index -q .dev-os/recovery/demo/scratch.tmp
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/checkpoints/
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/backend/
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/product/
git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/.last-extracted
```

**Expected results:**

| Command | Expected output |
|---------|----------------|
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/agents/git-automation.md` | No output, exit code 1 (not ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/config.yml` | No output, exit code 1 (not ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/profile/` | No output, exit code 1 (not ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/context-refresh-state.json` | `.gitignore:N:!.dev-os/runtime/context-refresh-state.json` (explicitly re-included) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/session-state.yml` | `.gitignore:N:.dev-os/runtime/*.yml` or the equivalent matching runtime rule |
| `git check-ignore --no-index -q .dev-os/recovery/demo/{checkpoint-1.yml,session-state.yml,ARCHIVED.yml}` | No output, exit code 1 (durable recovery files are not ignored) |
| `git check-ignore --no-index -q .dev-os/recovery/demo/scratch.tmp` | No output, exit code 0 (recovery scratch is ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/state/` | `.gitignore:N:.dev-os/state/` (ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/parallel-build-slice-current` | `.gitignore:N:.dev-os/runtime/*-current` (ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/logs/` | `.gitignore:N:.dev-os/logs/` (ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/cache/` | `.gitignore:N:.dev-os/cache/` (ignored) |
| `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/.last-extracted` | `.gitignore:N:.dev-os/standards/.last-extracted` (ignored) |

**Compliance checklist:**

- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/agents/git-automation.md` exits non-zero (authored — not ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/config.yml` exits non-zero (authored — not ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/profile/` exits non-zero (authored — not ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/context-refresh-state.json` exits zero and prints the `!.dev-os/runtime/context-refresh-state.json` negation rule (portable context — re-included)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/session-state.yml` exits zero and prints a `.dev-os/runtime/*.yml` match (runtime — ignored)?
- [ ] Each durable recovery snapshot check exits non-zero (checkpoint, session mirror, and archive marker are not ignored)?
- [ ] The recovery scratch check exits zero (scratch is ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/state/` exits zero and prints the `.gitignore` match (runtime — ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/runtime/parallel-build-slice-current` exits zero and prints a `.dev-os/runtime/*-current` match (runtime — ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/logs/` exits zero and prints the `.gitignore` match (runtime — ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/cache/` exits zero and prints the `.gitignore` match (runtime — ignored)?
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v .dev-os/standards/.last-extracted` exits zero and prints the `.gitignore` match (runtime — ignored)?

If any authored-dir check fails (dir is being ignored): remove the offending rule from `.gitignore`, then run `git add -f .dev-os/agents/ .dev-os/hooks/ .dev-os/workflows/ .dev-os/chains/ .dev-os/runbooks/ .dev-os/scripts/ .dev-os/bundles/ .dev-os/standards/global/ .dev-os/standards/profile/ .dev-os/config.yml` to restore tracked state.

If any runtime artifact check fails (artifact is not ignored): add the missing line to `.gitignore`, then run `git rm --cached -r .dev-os/<runtime-path>` only after verifying the file is generated and regenerable.

If the blanket `.dev-os/` anti-pattern is present, replace it with the explicit runtime-ignore block. Create a backup before rewriting `.gitignore` so the change is reversible.

---

## References

- **Convention over Configuration** (Rails Doctrine, DHH 2004) — Default behavior (tracking) applies to authored dirs; only deviations (runtime dirs) require explicit specification in `.gitignore`. This is why runtime dirs are enumerated but authored dirs are not.
- **RFC 2119 Normative Vocabulary** — `MUST`, `SHOULD`, `MAY` used with RFC 2119 semantics throughout this document to make compliance criteria unambiguous.
- **git-check-ignore(1)** — `git check-ignore -v <path>` is the canonical verification tool; it shows which `.gitignore` rule matches a path, or exits non-zero if no rule matches.
